title: Silence
description: Blank audio: nothing to hear, as long as you say (silence(10s)) or, with auto, as long as the block that holds it. Use it where a branch of a component has no sound, so a mix or an effect still has something to take.

parameters.name: length
parameters.doc: auto: as long as the block it is in. Or a time: 10 s, 500 ms.
